actions.description: Delete the exact DNS record selected by zone id and record id.

setup.fallback_reason: Use Cloudflare's permissions reference when building a custom token for a narrower zone scope.
setup.setup_note: Create a least-privilege API token with Zone Read and DNS Write for the zones the operator intends the agent to manage.
Store a Cloudflare API token in StackOS. Zone Read is needed for discovery and DNS Write is needed for record mutations.
